title: "WilcoxonRankSumTest_RandomDistSamplingScore_BB_NonBB"
author: "Ashtyn Gluck"
date: "2026-10-24"
output: html_document
---

```{r}
library(here)
library(readr)

# ---- USER SETTINGS ----
data_file <- here("Data", "All_SamplingScores", "Watershed_SupplementaryInformation_Final.csv")
# -----------------------

if (!file.exists(data_file)) {
  stop("Data file not found. See the README for where to download it: ", data_file)
}

random_samples <- read_csv(data_file)
```

```{r}
shapiro.test(random_samples$SamplingScore_RandomDistribution)
```
The p-value is below 0.05 indicating the data deviates from a normal distribution. Thus a non-parametric test must be used.

```{r}
BB_NonBB_SamplingScore_wilcoxon <- wilcox.test(SamplingScore_RandomDistribution ~ BB_or_NonBB, data = random_samples, alternative = "less")
BB_NonBB_SamplingScore_wilcoxon
```
